automations: Name of the special page and navigation item for managing wiki automations.
right-edit-wiki-automations:
{{doc-right|edit-wiki-automations}}
User right to edit wiki automations.
action-edit-wiki-automations:
{{doc-action|edit-wiki-automations}}
Action description shown in permission errors when a user lacks the right to edit wiki automations.
wiki-automations-desc: Description of the WikiAutomations extension shown on Special:Version and extension management pages.
wiki-automations-trigger-type-page: Label for trigger type representing events that occur on wiki pages.
wiki-automations-trigger-type-time: Label for trigger type representing events that occur at a specific time or schedule.
wiki-automations-page-filter-ns-label: Label for namespace filter field used to restrict automation to specific namespaces.
wiki-automations-content-action-edit: Label or description for an automation action that edits an existing page.
wiki-automations-content-action-create: Label or description for an automation action that creates a new page.
wiki-automations-trigger-edit: Label for trigger that runs automation when a page is edited.
wiki-automations-trigger-nightly: Label for trigger that runs automation every night automatically.
wiki-automations-trigger-schedule: Label for trigger that runs automation at a specific scheduled time.
wiki-automations-ui-panel-triggers: Header label for the panel listing automation triggers in the user interface.
wiki-automations-ui-panel-filters: Header label for the panel listing automation conditions or filters in the user interface.
wiki-automations-ui-panel-actions: Header label for the panel listing automation actions in the user interface.
wiki-automations-ui-action-add: Label for button or control used to add a new trigger, condition, or action.
wiki-automations-ui-dialog-trigger-picke: Header text for dialog that allows the user to select and add a trigger.
wiki-automations-ui-dialog-action-picker: Header text for dialog that allows the user to select and add an action.
wiki-automations-ui-action-save: Label for button used to save automation configuration changes.
wiki-automations-automation-disabled: Message shown when an automation is disabled and cannot be executed.
wiki-automations-action-no-pages: Error message shown when an automation action requires one or more pages but none were provided.
wiki-automations-time-trigger-pages-labe: Label for field specifying pages used by a time-based trigger.
wiki-automations-time-trigger-pages-help: Help text explaining how to specify pages for a time-based trigger. The expression must evaluate to a pipe-separated list of page names. If empty, no pages will be provided to the automation.
log-name-ext-wiki-automations: Name of the log type for wiki automations, shown in Special:Log.
log-description-ext-wiki-automations: Description of the wiki automations log, shown on Special:Log and Special:Log/ext-wiki-automations.
logentry-ext-wiki-automations-automation:
Log entry message shown when an automation run succeeds.

Parameters:
* $3 - Automation name or identifier
* $4 - Trigger description
* $5 - List of affected pages

Log entry message shown when an automation run completes with warnings.

Parameters:
* $3 - Automation name or identifier
* $4 - Trigger description
* $5 - Warning messages

Log entry message shown when an automation run fails.

Parameters:
* $3 - Automation name or identifier
* $4 - Trigger description
* $5 - Warning messages
* $6 - Error messages
wiki-automations-content-log-section-tit: Section title for displaying execution logs in the automation interface.
wiki-automations-trigger-delete: Label for trigger that runs automation when a page is deleted.
wiki-automations-trigger-prop-date: Label for trigger that runs automation based on a date stored in a page property.
wiki-automations-time-trigger-cron-days: Label for field allowing the user to select specific days of the week on which the scheduled trigger should run.
wiki-automations-time-trigger-cron-days-: Label for Monday as a selectable day in the scheduled trigger day picker.
Label for Tuesday as a selectable day in the scheduled trigger day picker.
Label for Wednesday as a selectable day in the scheduled trigger day picker.
Label for Thursday as a selectable day in the scheduled trigger day picker.
Label for Friday as a selectable day in the scheduled trigger day picker.
Label for Saturday as a selectable day in the scheduled trigger day picker.
Label for Sunday as a selectable day in the scheduled trigger day picker.
wiki-automations-time-trigger-cron-time: Label for the field specifying the time of day at which the scheduled trigger should run.
wiki-automations-log-more-pages:
Message indicating that more pages were affected by an automation run than are shown in the log entry.

Parameters:
* $1 - Number of additional pages not listed
wiki-automations-page-filter-content-lab: Label for checkbox filter that restricts automation to content pages only.
wiki-automations-page-filter-major-label: Label for checkbox filter that restricts automation to major (non-minor) revisions only.
wiki-automations-page-filter-content-pag: Label for the toggle field in the content-pages page filter that enables filtering to content namespaces only.
wiki-automations-page-filter-only-major-: Label for the toggle field in the only-major page filter that enables filtering to major (non-minor) edits only.
wiki-automations-edit-permission-require: Permission error message shown when a user without admin rights attempts to edit an automation page.
wiki-automations-ui-label-enabled: Label for the enabled/disabled toggle control in the automation editor.
wiki-automations-ui-action-cancel: Label for the cancel button in the automation editor dialogs.
wiki-automations-ui-action-next: Label for the next/continue button used to advance to the next step in the automation editor.
wiki-automations-editor-empty-trigger: Placeholder message shown in the triggers panel when no trigger has been configured yet. May contain HTML.
wiki-automations-editor-empty-conditions: Placeholder message shown in the conditions panel when no conditions have been configured yet. May contain HTML.
wiki-automations-editor-empty-actions: Placeholder message shown in the actions panel when no action has been configured yet. May contain HTML.
wiki-automations-ui-action-add-action: Label for the button that opens the action picker dialog to add a new action.
wiki-automations-ui-action-add-trigger: Label for the button that opens the trigger picker dialog to add a new trigger.
wiki-automations-ui-action-add-condition: Label for the button that opens the condition picker dialog to add a new page filter condition.
wiki-automations-ui-active: Status label shown when an automation is active (enabled).
wiki-automations-ui-inactive: Status label shown when an automation is inactive (disabled).
wiki-automations-ui-options: Label for the options menu or section in the automation editor.
wiki-automations-ui-action-disable: Label for the button that deactivates (disables) an automation.
wiki-automations-ui-action-enable: Label for the button that activates (enables) an automation.
wiki-automations-ui-action-edit: Label for the button that opens the automation editor.
wiki-automations-ui-action-delete: Label for the button that deletes an automation.
wiki-automations-ui-action-back: Label for the back button used to navigate to the previous step in the automation editor.
wiki-automations-time-trigger-display-ti:
Display text for a time-based trigger showing the configured run time.

Parameters:
* $1 - The formatted time of day
wiki-automations-time-trigger-display-ev: Display text for a time-based trigger indicating it runs every day (no specific days selected).
wiki-automations-time-trigger-display-pa: Label used in the display summary of a time-based trigger to indicate the pages it will operate on.
wiki-automations-ui-action-edit-entity: Label for the button that opens the edit dialog for an individual trigger, condition, or action entity.
wiki-automations-disabled-warning: Warning message displayed prominently when viewing an automation that is currently disabled.
wiki-automations-ui-action-edit-source: Label for the button that opens the raw source editor for the automation definition.
bs-extendedsearch-search-center-filter-d: Label for the filter option in the search interface that allows users to filter search results to show only automation pages.
wiki-automations-overview-column-title: Column header label for the automation name in the automations overview table.
wiki-automations-overview-column-namespa: Column header label for the namespace in the automations overview table.
wiki-automations-overview-action-create: Label for the button to create a new automation in the automations overview.
